```sql
WITH order_stats AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           sum(o.total_cents) AS revenue,
           count(*)           AS order_count,
           max(o.created_at)  AS last_order_at
      FROM orders o
      JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
     WHERE c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
     GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT customer_id, revenue, order_count, last_order_at
      FROM order_stats
     WHERE last_order_at >= %(from)s
       AND last_order_at <  %(to)s
     ORDER BY revenue DESC
     LIMIT %(limit)s
)
SELECT c.id,
       c.email,
       c.company,
       c.country_code,
       r.revenue,
       r.order_count,
       r.last_order_at
  FROM ranked r
  JOIN customers c ON c.id = r.customer_id
 ORDER BY r.revenue DESC
```

De tenantfilter wordt nu vóór de aggregatie toegepast, zodat alleen orders van de betreffende tenant worden gelezen, en `max(created_at)` vervangt de `DISTINCT ON`-sortering. Het aantal rijen wordt beperkt vóór de join met `customers`, en het resultaat is gelijk aan het origineel, behalve de volgorde van gelijke omzetwaarden, die in het origineel ook niet gegarandeerd is.
